name: kalien-cli
description: Kalien terminal client: key file, bots, submit, status

scripts.build:linux-x64: bun build src/index.ts src/worker/game-worker.ts --compile --outfile dist/kalien-linux-x64 --target bun-linux-x64
scripts.build:linux-arm64: bun build src/index.ts src/worker/game-worker.ts --compile --outfile dist/kalien-linux-arm64 --target bun-linux-arm64
scripts.build:macos-x64: bun build src/index.ts src/worker/game-worker.ts --compile --outfile dist/kalien-macos-x64 --target bun-darwin-x64
scripts.build:macos-arm64: bun build src/index.ts src/worker/game-worker.ts --compile --outfile dist/kalien-macos-arm64 --target bun-darwin-arm64
scripts.build:all: bun run build:linux-x64 && bun run build:linux-arm64 && bun run build:macos-x64 && bun run build:macos-arm64
